mapper.update: MERGE INTO INCOME t USING (SELECT #{memberId} AS MEMBER_ID, #{taxYear} AS TAX_YEAR FROM DUAL) s ON (t.MEMBER_ID = s.MEMBER_ID AND t.TAX_YEAR = s.TAX_YEAR) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.TOTAL_SALARY = #{req.totalSalary}, t.WITHHELD_TAX = #{req.withheldTax}, t.NATIONAL_PENSION = #{req.nationalPension}, t.HEALTH_INSURANCE = #{req.healthInsurance}, t.DEPENDENTS = #{req.dependents}, t.CHILDREN = #{req.children}, t.MONTHLY_RENT = #{req.monthlyRent}, t.HOUSING_SAVING = #{req.housingSaving}, t.PENSION_SAVING = #{req.pensionSaving}, t.IRP_SAVING = #{req.irpSaving}, t.SME_REDUCTION_YN = #{req.smeReductionYn}, t.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (INCOME_ID, MEMBER_ID, TAX_YEAR, TOTAL_SALARY, WITHHELD_TAX, NATIONAL_PENSION, HEALTH_INSURANCE, DEPENDENTS, CHILDREN, MONTHLY_RENT, HOUSING_SAVING, PENSION_SAVING, IRP_SAVING, SME_REDUCTION_YN) VALUES (SEQ_INCOME.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{taxYear}, #{req.totalSalary}, #{req.withheldTax}, #{req.nationalPension}, #{req.healthInsurance}, #{req.dependents}, #{req.children}, #{req.monthlyRent}, #{req.housingSaving}, #{req.pensionSaving}, #{req.irpSaving}, #{req.smeReductionYn})
